batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2022-2023, Set-I — full 80-question paper transcribed from the publisher question-bank PDF compilation (Medistry/Udvash) distributed via AdmissionWar/TargetPDF; cross-checked at paper level against the independent Udvash Academic & Admission Care compilation (abswer.com Drive PDF). Printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is; they are NOT official JU keys. Q3 is multiple_choice because the source solution itself states three options are correct. Q28/Q29 keys are marked unverified due to printed-key layout ambiguity. Cross-source answer-table check (Udvash compilation, book p.31): 77 of 80 printed keys agree with the Medistry compilation; Q15 and Q76 conflict between the two publisher keys and are marked answer-unverified (Q15: Medistry c vs Udvash b; Q76: Medistry a vs Udvash c — the Udvash value is recorded). Q28/Q29 keys (c/b) were confirmed by the Udvash table and are verified at publisher-key level.

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit question & solution 2022-2023 (Set-I), publisher question-bank compilation via AdmissionWar/TargetPDF
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned compilation PDF (29 pp., all JU A sets for 2022-2023), downloaded 2026-10-31 from https://targetpdf.files.wordpress.com/2024/01/ju-a-unit-question-solution-2022-2023.pdf (linked from https://admissionwar.com/en/ju-a-unit-question-bank-pdf/). Set-I occupies PDF pages 1-10 (book pages 1-10). Transcription by direct visual reading of every page; mathematical notation linearized with ^ for superscripts. Original PDF retained in RESEARCH_ARCHIVE.

examRules.sourceNote: Paper header states 80 marks, 55 minutes, -0.20 per wrong answer; these are transcribed from the compilation header only and are NOT entered as a verified scoring rule.
